name: VisuallyHidden
description: Keeps text in the accessibility tree while taking it off the screen.

when: An icon-only control needs a name
A link's text is vague out of context
A skip link needs to hide until focused
whenNot: Nobody should see or hear it (render nothing)
The content is just collapsed (use aria-expanded)
guidelines: Say the action, not the icon: "Search", not "magnifier"
Keep it short — it is read aloud
Visible text beats hidden text whenever there is room
accessibility: Screen readers announce it; the layout never moves
Focusable children inside still receive focus
Required for WCAG 2.1 on icon-only controls

examples.name: Icon Button Label
examples.description: The only thing telling a screen reader what this button does.

  <VisuallyHidden>Search</VisuallyHidden>
</button>
